test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given Idiom.

To be on a roll

options.text: To be experiencing a successful period
To be moving from place to place

solution:
The correct answer is Option 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the given idiom and others given in the options.
 
 
• **To be on a roll **means experiencing a prolonged spell of success or good luck

 
 
• Example:- Our team has been on a roll this season
 
 
 
• **To be experiencing setbacks **means experiencing a series of failures.
 
 
• Example:- Nowadays Indian cricket team is experiencing setbacks.
 
 
 
• **To be feeling extremely unhappy **means the situation of dissatisfied and dissatisfaction and sadness.
 
 
• Example:- He is feeling extremely unhappy.
 
 
 
• **To be moving from place to place **means** **the activity or process of moving someone or something from one place to another.
 
 
• Example:- Mr. Sharma is moving from place to place to find the solution to his business problems.
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the idiom's meaning, the correct answer is option1 i.e **To be experiencing a successful period.**
